parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page for paging queries.

Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the value of `NextToken` that was returned in the previous call. You do not need to set this parameter for the first request.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the port range list. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.
